PdfPreview.title: PDF Preview
PdfPreview.description: Compare three PDF preview implementations: react-pdf, iframe embed, and raw pdf.js
PdfPreview.reactPdfDescription: react-pdf@10: Document + Page components with paging and zoom, toolbar built from shadcn primitives
PdfPreview.embedDescription: iframe embeds the browser's native PDF viewer — zero deps, but iOS Safari renders only page 1
PdfPreview.pdfjsDescription: pdfjs-dist renders directly to canvas: the raw engine with full control

ImagePreview.title: Image Preview
ImagePreview.description: Click a thumbnail to open the lightbox; navigate with the arrow buttons or keyboard
ImagePreview.dialogDescription: Self-built Dialog + img lightbox: click a thumbnail to open the full image, with prev/next, index and keyboard support
ImagePreview.galleryDescription: @7ovr/gallery-1 community block: tag-filtered grid with hover info overlay and Dialog lightbox
ImagePreview.cambioDescription: @delta/cambio-image: click-to-zoom single image with IntersectionObserver lazy reveal and animated popup
ImagePreview.zoomDescription: @kibo-ui/image-zoom: wraps react-medium-image-zoom for smooth in-place zoom
ImagePreview.zoomHint: Click the image to try the zoom

Autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
Autocomplete.description: Five flavors of dropdown selection: plain single, plain multi, single with fuzzy search, multi with fuzzy search, and multi with fuzzy search plus type-to-create
Autocomplete.singleSelectDescription: Basic Select, pick one option, no search box
Autocomplete.multiSelectDescription: Select multiple options, no search box
Autocomplete.singleSearchDescription: Type to filter, tokenized matching (e.g. "py thon" matches Python)
Autocomplete.multiSearchDescription: Multi-select chips, type to filter, tokenized matching
Autocomplete.multiCreateDescription: Multi-select chips; typing a name that doesn't exist creates it (same as the customer picker on the invite tab of User Management)
